headline: Wixen damage boost
title: Wixen | Fire Attack Boost For You | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a cheap damage boost? Wixen has a partner skill called Lord Fox. When you activate it, your attacks gain the Fire element and attack goes up by thirty to fifty percent. At your base it also does Kindling level three and Handiwork level three. Will you try Wixen in your party? Comment below!
description: Wixen in Palworld 1.0 boosts your attack by thirty to fifty percent and adds Fire to your attacks with its partner skill.
